string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: Player lists (audio, subtitles, quality, seasons) in a right-hand panel with the movie visible beside it, bigger text and the position “1 of 5”
The chosen item stands out and the others get lighter and smaller, like the cross home screen; with move and select sounds
The “OK selects · back closes” hints sit inside the panel, without covering the movie subtitles
